find: because a flat public-art fee bears no essential nexus or rough proportionality to an interior renovation's impacts, it is an unconstitutional exaction
replace: if the parcel-specific demand is subject to exactions review, a flat public-art fee with no relation to an interior renovation's impacts fails essential nexus and rough proportionality. \textit{Sheetz} resolved the legislative-exemption issue and left other objections to monetary exactions open
reason: Sheetz did not hold that every legislative permit fee is an exaction subject to heightened review. Koontz distinguished qualifying parcel-linked demands from ordinary taxes and user fees.
source: https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/601/22-1074/ at slip op. 10–11 and 1–2 (Sotomayor, J., concurring); https://supreme.justia.com/cases/federal/us/570/595/ at 612–615
